info.name: Shurima Shop – Admin RESTful API
info.description:
Full CRUD collection for all Shurima Shop API endpoints organised by module.

Run order for end-to-end coverage:
Auth → Users → Categories → Brands → Products → Variants → Discounts → Carts → Cart Items → Orders → Order Items → Reviews → Payments

Required collection variables to set before running:
- adminEmail: email of a pre-seeded admin account
- adminPassword: password of that account
